verses.hebrew: הַצִּילֵנִי נָא מִיַּד אָחִי מִיַּד עֵשָׂו כִּי־יָרֵא אָנֹכִי אֹתוֹ פֶּן־יָבוֹא וְהִכַּנִי אֵם עַל־בָּנִים׃

verses.english: “But You said, ‘I will surely do you good and make your seed like the sand of the sea, which cannot be counted for its multitude.’”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה אָמַרְתָּ הֵיטֵב אֵיטִיב עִמָּךְ וְשַׂמְתִּי אֶת־זַרְעֲךָ כְּחוֹל הַיָּם אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יִסָּפֵר מֵרֹב׃

verses.english: He stayed there that night and selected a gift for Esau his brother from what he had with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּלֶן שָׁם בַּלַּיְלָה הַהוּא וַיִּקַּח מִן־הַבָּא בְיָדוֹ מִנְחָה לְעֵשָׂו אָחִיו׃

verses.english: two hundred she-goats and twenty he-goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,
verses.hebrew: עִזִּים מָאתַיִם וּתְיָשִׁים עֶשְׂרִים רְחֵלִים מָאתַיִם וְאֵילִים עֶשְׂרִים׃

verses.english: thirty nursing camels with their young, forty cows and ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.
verses.hebrew: גְּמַלִּים מֵינִיקוֹת וּבְנֵיהֶם שְׁלֹשִׁים פָּרוֹת אַרְבָּעִים וּפָרִים עֲשָׂרָה אֲתֹנֹת עֶשְׂרִים וַעְיָרִם עֲשָׂרָה׃

verses.english: And he delivered them into the hand of his servants, herd by herd apart; and he said to his servants, “Pass on before me, and make a space between herd and herd.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן בְּיַד־עֲבָדָיו עֵדֶר עֵדֶר לְבַדּוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־עֲבָדָיו עִבְרוּ לְפָנַי וְרֶוַח תָּשִׂימוּ בֵּין עֵדֶר וּבֵין עֵדֶר׃

verses.english: He commanded the first servant, “If my brother Esau meets you and asks, ‘Whose servant are you? Where are you going? Whose animals are these before you?’”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו אֶת־הָרִאשׁוֹן לֵאמֹר כִּי יִפְגָּשְׁךָ עֵשָׂו אָחִי וִשְׁאֵלְךָ לֵאמֹר לְמִי־אַתָּה וְאָנָה תֵלֵךְ וּלְמִי אֵלֶּה לְפָנֶיךָ׃

verses.english: “then say, ‘They belong to your servant Jacob. It is a gift sent to my lord Esau, and he himself is behind us.’”
verses.hebrew: וְאָמַרְתָּ לְעַבְדְּךָ לְיַעֲקֹב מִנְחָה הִוא שְׁלוּחָה לַאדֹנִי לְעֵשָׂו וְהִנֵּה גַם־הוּא אַחֲרֵינוּ׃

verses.english: And so he commanded the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “According to these words you shall speak to Esau when you find him.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְצַו גַּם אֶת־הַשֵּׁנִי גַּם אֶת־הַשְּׁלִישִׁי גַּם אֶת־כָּל־הַהֹלְכִים אַחֲרֵי הָעֲדָרִים לֵאמֹר כַּדָּבָר הַזֶּה תְּדַבְּרוּן אֶל־עֵשָׂו בְּמֹצַאֲכֶם אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: “Also say, ‘Your servant Jacob is behind us.’” For he thought, “I will appease him with the gift going before me; afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַרְתֶּם גַּם הִנֵּה עַבְדְּךָ יַעֲקֹב אַחֲרֵינוּ כִּי־אָמַר אֲכַפְּרָה פָנָיו בַּמִּנְחָה הַהֹלֶכֶת לְפָנָי וְאַחֲרֵי־כֵן אֶרְאֶה פָנָיו אוּלַי יִשָּׂא פָנָי׃

verses.english: The gift went ahead of him, while he spent that night in the camp.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעֲבֹר הַמִּנְחָה עַל־פָּנָיו וְהוּא לָן בַּלַּיְלָה־הַהוּא בַּמַּחֲנֶה׃

verses.english: And he rose up in the night and took his two wives, and his two slave women, and his eleven children, and crossed over the ford of Jabbok.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקָם בַּלַּיְלָה הוּא וַיִּקַּח אֶת־שְׁתֵּי נָשָׁיו וְאֶת־שְׁתֵּי שִׁפְחֹתָיו וְאֶת־אַחַד עָשָׂר יְלָדָיו וַיַּעֲבֹר אֵת מַעֲבַר יַבֹּק׃

verses.english: He took them and sent them across the stream, and sent over what he had.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֵם וַיַּעֲבִרֵם אֶת־הַנָּחַל וַיַּעֲבֵר אֶת־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ׃

verses.english: And Jacob was left behind alone; and a man wrestled with him until the dawn came up.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּוָּתֵר יַעֲקֹב לְבַדּוֹ וַיֵּאָבֵק אִישׁ עִמּוֹ עַד עֲלוֹת הַשָּׁחַר׃

verses.english: When the man saw that he could not prevail against him, he touched Jacob’s hip socket, and Jacob’s hip was dislocated as he wrestled with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא כִּי לֹא יָכֹל לוֹ וַיִּגַּע בְּכַף־יְרֵכוֹ וַתֵּקַע כַּף־יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּהֵאָבְקוֹ עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: And he said to him, “Let me go, for the dawn has risen.” But Jacob said, “I will not let you go, unless you bless me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שַׁלְּחֵנִי כִּי עָלָה הַשָּׁחַר וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא אֲשַׁלֵּחֲךָ כִּי אִם־בֵּרַכְתָּנִי׃

verses.english: Then he said to him, “What is your name?” And he said, “Jacob.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו מַה־שְּׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: He said, “Your name shall no longer be Jacob, but Israel, because you have striven with God and with men and have prevailed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא יַעֲקֹב יֵאָמֵר עוֹד שִׁמְךָ כִּי אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל כִּי־שָׂרִיתָ עִם־אֱלֹהִים וְעִם־אֲנָשִׁים וַתּוּכָל׃

verses.english: And Jacob asked and said, “Tell me your name.” And he said, “Why is it that you ask for my name?” And he blessed him there.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל יַעֲקֹב וַיֹּאמֶר הַגִּידָה־נָּא שְׁמֶךָ וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה תִּשְׁאַל לִשְׁמִי וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ שָׁם׃

verses.english: Jacob named the place Peniel, saying, “I have seen God face to face, and my life has been preserved.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם פְּנִיאֵל כִּי־רָאִיתִי אֱלֹהִים פָּנִים אֶל־פָּנִים וַתִּנָּצֵל נַפְשִׁי׃

verses.english: The sun rose upon him as he passed Penuel, and he was limping because of his hip.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּזְרַח־לוֹ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ כַּאֲשֶׁר עָבַר אֶת־פְּנוּאֵל וְהוּא צֹלֵעַ עַל־יְרֵכוֹ׃

verses.english: That is why, to this day, the Israelites do not eat the sciatic sinew at the hip socket: he struck the socket of Jacob’s hip at that sinew.
verses.hebrew: עַל־כֵּן לֹא־יֹאכְלוּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶת־גִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה אֲשֶׁר עַל־כַּף הַיָּרֵךְ עַד הַיּוֹם הַזֶּה כִּי נָגַע בְּכַף־יֶרֶךְ יַעֲקֹב בְּגִיד הַנָּשֶׁה׃

verses.english: Now Jacob looked up with his eyes and saw, and behold, Esau was coming, and with him were four hundred men. So he divided the children among Leah, Rachel, and the two slave women.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא יַעֲקֹב עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא וְהִנֵּה עֵשָׂו בָּא וְעִמּוֹ אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אִישׁ וַיַּחַץ אֶת־הַיְלָדִים עַל־לֵאָה וְעַל־רָחֵל וְעַל שְׁתֵּי הַשְּׁפָחוֹת׃

verses.english: And he put the slave women and their children in the front, Leah and her children next, and Rachel and Joseph last.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׂם אֶת־הַשְּׁפָחוֹת וְאֶת־יַלְדֵיהֶן רִאשֹׁנָה וְאֶת־לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ אַחֲרֹנִים וְאֶת־רָחֵל וְאֶת־יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֹנִים׃

verses.english: He himself went on before them and bowed down upon the earth seven times until he came near to his brother.
verses.hebrew: וְהוּא עָבַר לִפְנֵיהֶם וַיִּשְׁתַּחוּ אַרְצָה שֶׁבַע פְּעָמִים עַד־גִּשְׁתּוֹ עַד־אָחִיו׃

verses.english: And Esau ran to meet him, and embraced him, and fell on his neck, and kissed him, and they both wept.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּרָץ עֵשָׂו לִקְרָאתוֹ וַיְחַבְּקֵהוּ וַיִּפֹּל עַל־צַוָּארָו וַיִּשָּׁקֵהוּ וַיִּבְכּוּ׃

verses.english: He looked up and saw the women and children and asked, “Who are these with you?” Jacob said, “The children God has graciously given your servant.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינָיו וַיַּרְא אֶת־הַנָּשִׁים וְאֶת־הַיְלָדִים וַיֹּאמֶר מִי־אֵלֶּה לָּךְ וַיֹּאמַר הַיְלָדִים אֲשֶׁר־חָנַן אֱלֹהִים אֶת־עַבְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Then the slave women and their children drew near and bowed down.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּגַּשְׁןָ הַשְּׁפָחוֹת הֵנָּה וְיַלְדֵיהֶן וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ׃

verses.english: And Leah also and her children drew near and bowed down; and afterward Joseph and Rachel drew near and bowed down.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּגַּשׁ גַּם־לֵאָה וִילָדֶיהָ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ וְאַחַר נִגַּשׁ יוֹסֵף וְרָחֵל וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ׃

verses.english: Esau asked, “What did you mean by all this company I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in my lord’s sight.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מִי לְךָ כָּל־הַמַּחֲנֶה הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר פָּגָשְׁתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לִמְצֹא־חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

verses.english: But Esau said, “I have plenty, my brother; keep what is yours for yourself.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו יֶשׁ־לִי רָב אָחִי יְהִי לְךָ אֲשֶׁר־לָךְ׃

verses.english: Jacob said, “No, please. If I have found favor in your sight, accept my gift from my hand. Seeing your face has been like seeing the face of God, and you have accepted me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אַל־נָא אִם־נָא מָצָאתִי חֵן בְּעֵינֶיךָ וְלָקַחְתָּ מִנְחָתִי מִיָּדִי כִּי עַל־כֵּן רָאִיתִי פָנֶיךָ כִּרְאֹת פְּנֵי אֱלֹהִים וַתִּרְצֵנִי׃

verses.english: “Please accept my blessing that has been brought to you, for God has dealt graciously with me, and I have enough.” He urged him, and Esau accepted it.
verses.hebrew: קַח־נָא אֶת־בִּרְכָתִי אֲשֶׁר הֻבָאת לָךְ כִּי־חַנַּנִי אֱלֹהִים וְכִי יֶשׁ־לִי־כֹל וַיִּפְצַר־בּוֹ וַיִּקָּח׃

verses.english: Esau said, “Let us journey on, and I will go beside you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר נִסְעָה וְנֵלֵכָה וְאֵלְכָה לְנֶגְדֶּךָ׃

verses.english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and I must care for the nursing flocks and herds. If they are driven hard for one day, all the flock will die.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלָיו אֲדֹנִי יֹדֵעַ כִּי־הַיְלָדִים רַכִּים וְהַצֹּאן וְהַבָּקָר עָלוֹת עָלָי וּדְפָקוּם יוֹם אֶחָד וָמֵתוּ כָּל־הַצֹּאן׃

verses.english: “Let my lord go ahead of his servant. I will lead on gently at the pace of the livestock before me and of the children, until I come to my lord in Seir.”
verses.hebrew: יַעֲבָר־נָא אֲדֹנִי לִפְנֵי עַבְדּוֹ וַאֲנִי אֶתְנָהֲלָה לְאִטִּי לְרֶגֶל הַמְּלָאכָה אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנַי וּלְרֶגֶל הַיְלָדִים עַד אֲשֶׁר־אָבֹא אֶל־אֲדֹנִי שֵׂעִירָה׃

verses.english: And Esau said, “Let me leave with you some of the people who are with me.” But he said, “Why is this necessary? Let me find grace in the sight of my lord.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר עֵשָׂו אַצִּיגָה־נָּא עִמְּךָ מִן־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר אִתִּי וַיֹּאמֶר לָמָּה זֶּה אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֵי אֲדֹנִי׃

verses.english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא עֵשָׂו לְדַרְכּוֹ שֵׂעִירָה׃

verses.english: Jacob traveled to Succoth. He built himself a house and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore he named the place Succoth.
verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב נָסַע סֻכֹּתָה וַיִּבֶן לוֹ בָּיִת וּלְמִקְנֵהוּ עָשָׂה סֻכֹּת עַל־כֵּן קָרָא שֵׁם־הַמָּקוֹם סֻכּוֹת׃

verses.english: Jacob arrived safely at the city of Shechem in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan-aram. He camped in front of the city.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב שָׁלֵם עִיר שְׁכֶם אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיִּחַן אֶת־פְּנֵי הָעִיר׃

verses.english: He bought the plot of ground where he had pitched his tent from the sons of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred kesitahs.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקֶן אֶת־חֶלְקַת הַשָּׂדֶה אֲשֶׁר נָטָה־שָׁם אָהֳלוֹ מִיַּד בְּנֵי־חֲמוֹר אֲבִי שְׁכֶם בְּמֵאָה קְשִׂיטָה׃

verses.english: He erected an altar there and named it El-Elohe-Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֶּב־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא־לוֹ אֵל אֱלֹהֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: Dinah, the daughter Leah had borne to Jacob, went out to see the women of the land.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּצֵא דִינָה בַּת־לֵאָה אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה לְיַעֲקֹב לִרְאוֹת בִּבְנוֹת הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Shechem, son of Hamor the Hivite, a ruler of the land, saw her. He seized her, lay with her, and violated her.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֹתָהּ שְׁכֶם בֶּן־חֲמוֹר הַחִוִּי נְשִׂיא הָאָרֶץ וַיִּקַּח אֹתָהּ וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֹתָהּ וַיְעַנֶּהָ׃

verses.english: His soul clung to Dinah, Jacob’s daughter. He loved the young woman and spoke tenderly to her.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּדְבַּק נַפְשׁוֹ בְּדִינָה בַּת־יַעֲקֹב וַיֶּאֱהַב אֶת־הַנַּעֲרָ וַיְדַבֵּר עַל־לֵב הַנַּעֲרָ׃

verses.english: So Shechem spoke to Hamor, his father, saying, “Take this young girl for me as a wife.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁכֶם אֶל־חֲמוֹר אָבִיו לֵאמֹר קַח־לִי אֶת־הַיַּלְדָּה הַזֹּאת לְאִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; but his sons were with his cattle in the field, so Jacob kept silent until they came.
verses.hebrew: וְיַעֲקֹב שָׁמַע כִּי טִמֵּא אֶת־דִּינָה בִתּוֹ וּבָנָיו הָיוּ אֶת־מִקְנֵהוּ בַּשָּׂדֶה וְהֶחֱרִשׁ יַעֲקֹב עַד־בֹּאָם׃

verses.english: Then Hamor, the father of Shechem, went out to Jacob to speak to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּצֵא חֲמוֹר אֲבִי־שְׁכֶם אֶל־יַעֲקֹב לְדַבֵּר אִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: Jacob’s sons came from the field when they heard. The men were grieved and very angry, because he had committed an outrage in Israel by lying with Jacob’s daughter. Such a thing ought not to be done.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי יַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ מִן־הַשָּׂדֶה כְּשָׁמְעָם וַיִּתְעַצְּבוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים וַיִּחַר לָהֶם מְאֹד כִּי־נְבָלָה עָשָׂה בְיִשְׂרָאֵל לִשְׁכַּב אֶת־בַּת־יַעֲקֹב וְכֵן לֹא יֵעָשֶׂה׃

verses.english: And Hamor spoke to them, saying, “The soul of my son Shechem longs for your daughter; give her to him, I pray, as a wife.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר חֲמוֹר אִתָּם לֵאמֹר שְׁכֶם בְּנִי חָשְׁקָה נַפְשׁוֹ בְּבִתְּכֶם תְּנוּ נָא אֹתָהּ לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: “Make marriages with us; give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִתְחַתְּנוּ אֹתָנוּ בְּנֹתֵיכֶם תִּתְּנוּ־לָנוּ וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵינוּ תִּקְחוּ לָכֶם׃

verses.english: “And you shall dwell with us, and the land shall be before you; dwell and trade in it, and acquire possessions in it.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִתָּנוּ תֵּשֵׁבוּ וְהָאָרֶץ תִּהְיֶה לִפְנֵיכֶם שְׁבוּ וּסְחָרוּהָ וְהֵאָחֲזוּ בָּהּ׃

verses.english: Shechem said to her father and brothers, “Let me find favor in your sight; I will give whatever you ask of me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר שְׁכֶם אֶל־אָבִיה וְאֶל־אַחֶיהָ אֶמְצָא־חֵן בְּעֵינֵיכֶם וַאֲשֶׁר תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלַי אֶתֵּן׃

verses.english: “Ask of me a very great bride-price and gift, and I will give whatever you say. Only give me the young woman as a wife.”
verses.hebrew: הַרְבּוּ עָלַי מְאֹד מֹהַר וּמַתָּן וְאֶתְּנָה כַּאֲשֶׁר תֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָי וּתְנוּ־לִי אֶת־הַנַּעֲרָ לְאִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: Jacob’s sons answered Shechem and Hamor his father deceitfully, because he had defiled their sister Dinah.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲנוּ בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב אֶת־שְׁכֶם וְאֶת־חֲמוֹר אָבִיו בְּמִרְמָה וַיְדַבֵּרוּ אֲשֶׁר טִמֵּא אֵת דִּינָה אֲחֹתָם׃

verses.english: They said to them, “We cannot do this: give our sister to an uncircumcised man, for that would be a disgrace to us.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֲלֵיהֶם לֹא נוּכַל לַעֲשׂוֹת הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה לָתֵת אֶת־אֲחֹתֵנוּ לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ עָרְלָה כִּי־חֶרְפָּה הִוא לָנוּ׃

verses.english: “Only on this condition will we agree with you: become like us by circumcising every male among you.”
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּזֹאת נֵאוֹת לָכֶם אִם תִּהְיוּ כָמֹנוּ לְהִמֹּל לָכֶם כָּל־זָכָר׃

verses.english: “Then we will give our daughters to you and take your daughters for ourselves. We will live with you and become one people.”
verses.hebrew: וְנָתַנּוּ אֶת־בְּנֹתֵינוּ לָכֶם וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵיכֶם נִקַּח־לָנוּ וְיָשַׁבְנוּ אִתְּכֶם וְהָיִינוּ לְעַם אֶחָד׃

verses.english: “If you will not listen to us and be circumcised, we will take our daughter and leave.”
verses.hebrew: וְאִם־לֹא תִשְׁמְעוּ אֵלֵינוּ לְהִמּוֹל וְלָקַחְנוּ אֶת־בִּתֵּנוּ וְהָלָכְנוּ׃

verses.english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטְבוּ דִבְרֵיהֶם בְּעֵינֵי חֲמוֹר וּבְעֵינֵי שְׁכֶם בֶּן־חֲמוֹר׃

verses.english: The young man did not delay doing this, because he delighted in Jacob’s daughter. He was the most honored in all his father’s household.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־אֵחַר הַנַּעַר לַעֲשׂוֹת הַדָּבָר כִּי חָפֵץ בְּבַת־יַעֲקֹב וְהוּא נִכְבָּד מִכֹּל בֵּית אָבִיו׃

verses.english: So Hamor and Shechem his son came to the gate of their city, and spoke to the men of their city, saying,
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא חֲמוֹר וּשְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ אֶל־שַׁעַר עִירָם וַיְדַבְּרוּ אֶל־אַנְשֵׁי עִירָם לֵאמֹר׃

verses.english: “These men are peaceful with us; therefore let them dwell in the land and trade in it, for behold, the land is broad enough before them. Let us take their daughters for wives, and let us give them our daughters.”
verses.hebrew: הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה שְׁלֵמִים הֵם אִתָּנוּ וְיֵשְׁבוּ בָאָרֶץ וְיִסְחֲרוּ אֹתָהּ וְהָאָרֶץ הִנֵּה רַחֲבַת־יָדַיִם לִפְנֵיהֶם אֶת־בְּנֹתָם נִקַּח־לָנוּ לְנָשִׁים וְאֶת־בְּנֹתֵינוּ נִתֵּן לָהֶם׃

verses.english: “Only on this condition will the men consent to dwell with us to be one people: if every male among us is circumcised, just as they are circumcised.”
verses.hebrew: אַךְ־בְּזֹאת יֵאֹתוּ לָנוּ הָאֲנָשִׁים לָשֶׁבֶת אִתָּנוּ לִהְיוֹת לְעַם אֶחָד בְּהִמּוֹל לָנוּ כָּל־זָכָר כַּאֲשֶׁר הֵם נִמֹּלִים׃

verses.english: “Shall not their cattle, their possessions, and all their animals be ours? Only let us consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”
verses.hebrew: מִקְנֵהֶם וְקִנְיָנָם וְכָל־בְּהֶמְתָּם הֲלוֹא לָנוּ הֵם אַךְ נֵאוֹתָה לָהֶם וְיֵשְׁבוּ אִתָּנוּ׃

verses.english: And all who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶל־חֲמוֹר וְאֶל־שְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ כָּל־יֹצְאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ וַיִּמֹּלוּ כָּל־זָכָר כָּל־יֹצְאֵי שַׁעַר עִירוֹ׃

verses.english: On the third day, while they were in pain, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, entered the city unopposed, and killed every male.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי בִּהְיוֹתָם כֹּאֲבִים וַיִּקְחוּ שְׁנֵי־בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב שִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי אֲחֵי דִינָה אִישׁ חַרְבּוֹ וַיָּבֹאוּ עַל־הָעִיר בֶּטַח וַיַּהַרְגוּ כָּל־זָכָר׃

verses.english: And they killed Hamor and Shechem his son with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־חֲמוֹר וְאֶת־שְׁכֶם בְּנוֹ הָרְגוּ לְפִי־חָרֶב וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־דִּינָה מִבֵּית שְׁכֶם וַיֵּצֵאוּ׃

verses.english: Jacob’s sons came upon the slain and plundered the city where their sister had been defiled.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב בָּאוּ עַל־הַחֲלָלִים וַיָּבֹזּוּ הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר טִמְּאוּ אֲחוֹתָם׃

verses.english: They took their sheep, their oxen, their donkeys, and whatever was in the city and whatever was in the field;
verses.hebrew: אֶת־צֹאנָם וְאֶת־בְּקָרָם וְאֶת־חֲמֹרֵיהֶּם וְאֵת אֲשֶׁר־בָּעִיר וְאֶת־אֲשֶׁר בַּשָּׂדֶה לָקָחוּ׃

verses.english: They took all their wealth, children, and wives captive, and plundered everything in the houses.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־כָּל־חֵילָם וְאֶת־כָּל־טַפָּם וְאֶת־נְשֵׁיהֶם שָׁבוּ וַיָּבֹזּוּ וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר בַּבָּיִת׃

verses.english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have brought trouble on me by making me odious to the people of the land, the Canaanites and Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather against me and strike me, and my household and I will be destroyed.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־שִׁמְעוֹן וְאֶל־לֵוִי עֲכַרְתֶּם אֹתִי לְהַבְאִישֵׁנִי בְּיֹשֵׁב הָאָרֶץ בַּכְּנַעֲנִי וּבַפְּרִזִּי וַאֲנִי מְתֵי מִסְפָּר וְנֶאֶסְפוּ עָלַי וְהִכּוּנִי וְנִשְׁמַדְתִּי אֲנִי וּבֵיתִי׃

verses.english: But they said, “Should he have treated our sister like a prostitute?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ הַכְזוֹנָה יַעֲשֶׂה אֶת־אֲחוֹתֵנוּ׃

verses.english: Then God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel and settle there; and make an altar there to the God who appeared to you when you fled from your brother Esau.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־יַעֲקֹב קוּם עֲלֵה בֵית־אֵל וְשֶׁב־שָׁם וַעֲשֵׂה־שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הַנִּרְאֶה אֵלֶיךָ בְּבָרְחֲךָ מִפְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אָחִיךָ׃

verses.english: So Jacob said to his household and to all who were with him, “Get rid of the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יַעֲקֹב אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עִמּוֹ הָסִרוּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּתֹכְכֶם וְהִטַּהֲרוּ וְהַחֲלִיפוּ שִׂמְלֹתֵיכֶם׃

verses.english: “Let us arise and go up to Bethel. I will make an altar there to the God who answered me in the day of my distress and was with me on the road I traveled.”
verses.hebrew: וְנָקוּמָה וְנַעֲלֶה בֵּית־אֵל וְאֶעֱשֶׂה־שָּׁם מִזְבֵּחַ לָאֵל הָעֹנֶה אֹתִי בְּיוֹם צָרָתִי וַיְהִי עִמָּדִי בַּדֶּרֶךְ אֲשֶׁר הָלָכְתִּי׃

verses.english: So they gave to Jacob all the foreign gods they possessed, and the rings that were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the terebinth tree near Shechem.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתְּנוּ אֶל־יַעֲקֹב אֵת כָּל־אֱלֹהֵי הַנֵּכָר אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדָם וְאֶת־הַנְּזָמִים אֲשֶׁר בְּאָזְנֵיהֶם וַיִּטְמֹן אֹתָם יַעֲקֹב תַּחַת הָאֵלָה אֲשֶׁר עִם־שְׁכֶם׃

verses.english: They set out, and a terror from God fell on the surrounding cities, so they did not pursue Jacob’s sons.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסָּעוּ וַיְהִי חִתַּת אֱלֹהִים עַל־הֶעָרִים אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֵיהֶם וְלֹא רָדְפוּ אַחֲרֵי בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב׃

verses.english: And Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב לוּזָה אֲשֶׁר בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנַעַן הִוא בֵּית־אֵל הוּא וְכָל־הָעָם אֲשֶׁר־עִמּוֹ׃

verses.english: He built an altar there and named the place El-bethel, because God had revealed Himself to him there when he fled from his brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּבֶן שָׁם מִזְבֵּחַ וַיִּקְרָא לַמָּקוֹם אֵל בֵּית־אֵל כִּי שָׁם נִגְלוּ אֵלָיו הָאֱלֹהִים בְּבָרְחוֹ מִפְּנֵי אָחִיו׃

verses.english: Now Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died and was buried below Bethel under the oak; and he called its name Allon-Bacuth.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּמָת דְּבֹרָה מֵינֶקֶת רִבְקָה וַתִּקָּבֵר מִתַּחַת לְבֵית־אֵל תַּחַת הָאַלּוֹן וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ אַלּוֹן בָּכוּת׃

verses.english: God appeared to Jacob again when he came from Paddan-aram, and blessed him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרָא אֱלֹהִים אֶל־יַעֲקֹב עוֹד בְּבֹאוֹ מִפַּדַּן אֲרָם וַיְבָרֶךְ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: And God said to him, “Your name is Jacob; no longer shall your name be called Jacob, but Israel shall be your name.” So He named him Israel.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר־לוֹ אֱלֹהִים שִׁמְךָ יַעֲקֹב לֹא־יִקָּרֵא שִׁמְךָ עוֹד יַעֲקֹב כִּי אִם־יִשְׂרָאֵל יִהְיֶה שְׁמֶךָ וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: God said to him, “I am El Shaddai. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and an assembly of nations shall come from you, and kings shall come from your loins.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ אֱלֹהִים אֲנִי אֵל שַׁדַּי פְּרֵה וּרְבֵה גּוֹי וּקְהַל גּוֹיִם יִהְיֶה מִמֶּךָּ וּמְלָכִים מֵחֲלָצֶיךָ יֵצֵאוּ׃

verses.english: “The land I gave to Abraham and Isaac I will give to you, and I will give the land to your seed after you.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־הָאָרֶץ אֲשֶׁר נָתַתִּי לְאַבְרָהָם וּלְיִצְחָק לְךָ אֶתְּנֶנָּה וּלְזַרְעֲךָ אַחֲרֶיךָ אֶתֵּן אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Then God went up from him at the place where He had spoken with him.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַל מֵעָלָיו אֱלֹהִים בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ׃

verses.english: And Jacob set up a pillar in the place where He had spoken with him, a pillar of stone; and he poured out a drink offering on it and poured oil upon it.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה בַּמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ מַצֶּבֶת אָבֶן וַיַּסֵּךְ עָלֶיהָ נֶסֶךְ וַיִּצֹק עָלֶיהָ שָׁמֶן׃

verses.english: So Jacob called the name of the place where God had spoken with him, Bethel.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יַעֲקֹב אֶת־שֵׁם הַמָּקוֹם אֲשֶׁר דִּבֶּר אִתּוֹ שָׁם אֱלֹהִים בֵּית־אֵל׃

verses.english: [aligned with RH 35:16b] They journeyed from Bethel. While there was still some distance to Ephrath, Rachel went into labor, and her labor was hard.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסְעוּ מִבֵּית אֵל וַיְהִי־עוֹד כִּבְרַת־הָאָרֶץ לָבוֹא אֶפְרָתָה וַתֵּלֶד רָחֵל וַתְּקַשׁ בְּלִדְתָּהּ׃

verses.english: And it came to pass during her difficult labor, that the midwife said to her, “Do not fear, for this is also a son for you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְהַקְשֹׁתָהּ בְּלִדְתָּהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהּ הַמְיַלֶּדֶת אַל־תִּירְאִי כִּי־גַם־זֶה לָךְ בֵּן׃

verses.english: As her life was departing, for she was dying, she named him Ben-oni; but his father named him Benjamin.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּצֵאת נַפְשָׁהּ כִּי מֵתָה וַתִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֶּן־אוֹנִי וְאָבִיו קָרָא־לוֹ בִנְיָמִין׃

verses.english: So Rachel died and was buried on the way to Ephrath (that is, Bethlehem).
verses.hebrew: וַתָּמָת רָחֵל וַתִּקָּבֵר בְּדֶרֶךְ אֶפְרָתָה הִוא בֵּית לָחֶם׃

verses.english: And Jacob set up a pillar over her grave; this is the pillar of Rachel’s grave until this day.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּצֵּב יַעֲקֹב מַצֵּבָה עַל־קְבֻרָתָהּ הִוא מַצֶּבֶת קְבֻרַת־רָחֵל עַד־הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: [aligned with RH 35:16a] Israel journeyed on and pitched his tent beyond Migdal-eder.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּסַּע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיֵּט אָהֳלֹה מֵהָלְאָה לְמִגְדַּל־עֵדֶר׃

verses.english: While Israel was living in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת־בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: Now Jacob’s sons were twelve:
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּשְׁכֹּן יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּאָרֶץ הַהִוא וַיֵּלֶךְ רְאוּבֵן וַיִּשְׁכַּב אֶת־בִּלְהָה פִּילֶגֶשׁ אָבִיו וַיִּשְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־יַעֲקֹב שְׁנֵים עָשָׂר׃

verses.english: The sons of Leah: Reuben, the firstborn of Jacob, then Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי לֵאָה בְּכוֹר יַעֲקֹב רְאוּבֵן וְשִׁמְעוֹן וְלֵוִי וִיהוּדָה וְיִשָּׂשכָר וּזְבוּלֻן׃

verses.english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.hebrew: בְּנֵי רָחֵל יוֹסֵף וּבִנְיָמִן׃

verses.english: The sons of Bilhah, Rachel’s slave woman: Dan and Naphtali.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי בִלְהָה שִׁפְחַת רָחֵל דָּן וְנַפְתָּלִי׃

verses.english: And the sons of Zilpah, Leah’s slave woman: Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan-aram.
verses.hebrew: וּבְנֵי זִלְפָּה שִׁפְחַת לֵאָה גָּד וְאָשֵׁר אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אֲשֶׁר יֻלַּד־לוֹ בְּפַדַּן אֲרָם׃

verses.english: Jacob came to Isaac his father at Mamre, Kiriath-arba, which is Hebron, where Abraham and Isaac had lived as foreigners.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא יַעֲקֹב אֶל־יִצְחָק אָבִיו מַמְרֵא קִרְיַת הָאַרְבַּע הִוא חֶבְרוֹן אֲשֶׁר־גָּר־שָׁם אַבְרָהָם וְיִצְחָק׃

verses.english: And the days of Isaac were one hundred and eighty years.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ יְמֵי יִצְחָק מְאַת שָׁנָה וּשְׁמֹנִים שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: Isaac breathed his last and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. His sons Esau and Jacob buried him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּגְוַע יִצְחָק וַיָּמָת וַיֵּאָסֶף אֶל־עַמָּיו זָקֵן וּשְׂבַע יָמִים וַיִּקְבְּרוּ אֹתוֹ עֵשָׂו וְיַעֲקֹב בָּנָיו׃

verses.english: Now these are the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah, daughter of Elon the Hittite, and Oholibamah, daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon the Hivite,
verses.hebrew: עֵשָׂו לָקַח אֶת־נָשָׁיו מִבְּנוֹת כְּנָעַן אֶת־עָדָה בַּת־אֵילוֹן הַחִתִּי וְאֶת־אָהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת־עֲנָה בַּת־צִבְעוֹן הַחִוִּי׃

verses.english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, the sister of Nebaioth.
verses.hebrew: וְאֶת־בָּשְׂמַת בַּת־יִשְׁמָעֵאל אֲחוֹת נְבָיוֹת׃

verses.english: And Adah bore Eliphaz to Esau, and Basemath bore Reuel.
verses.hebrew: וַתֵּלֶד עָדָה לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־אֱלִיפָז וּבָשְׂמַת יָלְדָה אֶת־רְעוּאֵל׃

verses.english: And Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau who were born to him in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: וְאָהֳלִיבָמָה יָלְדָה אֶת־יעיש [יְעוּשׁ] וְאֶת־יַעְלָם וְאֶת־קֹרַח אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עֵשָׂו אֲשֶׁר יֻלְּדוּ־לוֹ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: Esau took his wives, sons, daughters, everyone in his household, his livestock, all his animals, and all the belongings he had acquired in Canaan, and went to another land away from Jacob his brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח עֵשָׂו אֶת־נָשָׁיו וְאֶת־בָּנָיו וְאֶת־בְּנֹתָיו וְאֶת־כָּל־נַפְשׁוֹת בֵּיתוֹ וְאֶת־מִקְנֵהוּ וְאֶת־כָּל־בְּהֶמְתּוֹ וְאֵת כָּל־קִנְיָנוֹ אֲשֶׁר רָכַשׁ בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן וַיֵּלֶךְ אֶל־אֶרֶץ מִפְּנֵי יַעֲקֹב אָחִיו׃

verses.english: For their possessions were too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their sojourning could not support them because of their livestock.
verses.hebrew: כִּי־הָיָה רְכוּשָׁם רָב מִשֶּׁבֶת יַחְדָּו וְלֹא יָכְלָה אֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵיהֶם לָשֵׂאת אֹתָם מִפְּנֵי מִקְנֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: So Esau dwelt in the hill country of Seir; Esau is Edom.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב עֵשָׂו בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר עֵשָׂו הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: And these are the generations of Esau, the father of Edom in the hill country of Seir.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם בְּהַר שֵׂעִיר׃

verses.english: These are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Esau’s wife Adah, and Reuel, the son of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת בְּנֵי־עֵשָׂו אֱלִיפַז בֶּן־עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו רְעוּאֵל בֶּן־בָּשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: And the sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, Gatam, and Kenaz.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְּנֵי אֱלִיפָז תֵּימָן אוֹמָר צְפוֹ וְגַעְתָּם וּקְנַז׃

verses.english: Now Timna was a concubine of Esau’s son Eliphaz, and she bore Amalek to Eliphaz. These are the descendants of Esau’s wife Adah.
verses.hebrew: וְתִמְנַע הָיְתָה פִילֶגֶשׁ לֶאֱלִיפַז בֶּן־עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לֶאֱלִיפַז אֶת־עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: And these are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Esau’s wife Basemath.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל נַחַת וָזֶרַח שַׁמָּה וּמִזָּה אֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: And these were the sons of Esau’s wife Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, daughter of Zibeon: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הָיוּ בְּנֵי אָהֳלִיבָמָה בַת־עֲנָה בַּת־צִבְעוֹן אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו וַתֵּלֶד לְעֵשָׂו אֶת־יעיש [יְעוּשׁ] וְאֶת־יַעְלָם וְאֶת־קֹרַח׃

verses.english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau. The sons of Eliphaz, the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי בְנֵי־עֵשָׂו בְּנֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּכוֹר עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף אוֹמָר אַלּוּף צְפוֹ אַלּוּף קְנַז׃

verses.english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, and chief Amalek. These are the chiefs of Eliphaz in the land of Edom; these are the descendants of Adah.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף־קֹרַח אַלּוּף גַּעְתָּם אַלּוּף עֲמָלֵק אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱלִיפַז בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי עָדָה׃

verses.english: And these are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, and chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs of Reuel in the land of Edom; these are the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי רְעוּאֵל בֶּן־עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף נַחַת אַלּוּף זֶרַח אַלּוּף שַׁמָּה אַלּוּף מִזָּה אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי רְעוּאֵל בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי בָשְׂמַת אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: And these are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, and chief Korah. These are the chiefs born of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי אָהֳלִיבָמָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו אַלּוּף יְעוּשׁ אַלּוּף יַעְלָם אַלּוּף קֹרַח אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אָהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת־עֲנָה אֵשֶׁת עֵשָׂו׃

verses.english: These are Esau’s sons, and these are their chiefs. He is Edom.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־עֵשָׂו וְאֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵיהֶם הוּא אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, and Anah,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־שֵׂעִיר הַחֹרִי יֹשְׁבֵי הָאָרֶץ לוֹטָן וְשׁוֹבָל וְצִבְעוֹן וַעֲנָה׃

verses.english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan; these are the chiefs of the Horites, the sons of Seir in the land of Edom.
verses.hebrew: וְדִשׁוֹן וְאֵצֶר וְדִישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי בְּנֵי שֵׂעִיר בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: And the sons of Lotan were Hori and Hemam; and Lotan’s sister was Timna.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּהְיוּ בְנֵי־לוֹטָן חֹרִי וְהֵימָם וַאֲחוֹת לוֹטָן תִּמְנָע׃

verses.english: These are the sons of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי שׁוֹבָל עַלְוָן וּמָנַחַת וְעֵיבָל שְׁפוֹ וְאוֹנָם׃

verses.english: Zibeon’s sons were Aiah and Anah. This is the Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness while tending his father Zibeon’s donkeys.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי־צִבְעוֹן וְאַיָּה וַעֲנָה הוּא עֲנָה אֲשֶׁר מָצָא אֶת־הַיֵּמִם בַּמִּדְבָּר בִּרְעֹתוֹ אֶת־הַחֲמֹרִים לְצִבְעוֹן אָבִיו׃

verses.english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְנֵי־עֲנָה דִּשֹׁן וְאָהֳלִיבָמָה בַּת־עֲנָה׃

verses.english: And these are the sons of Dishan: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה בְּנֵי דִישָׁן חֶמְדָּן וְאֶשְׁבָּן וְיִתְרָן וּכְרָן׃

verses.english: These are Ezer’s sons: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְּנֵי־אֵצֶר בִּלְהָן וְזַעֲוָן וַעֲקָן׃

verses.english: These are the sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה בְנֵי־דִישָׁן עוּץ וַאֲרָן׃

verses.english: These are the chiefs of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי אַלּוּף לוֹטָן אַלּוּף שׁוֹבָל אַלּוּף צִבְעוֹן אַלּוּף עֲנָה׃

verses.english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs of the Horites, according to their principalities in the land of Seir.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף דִּשֹׁן אַלּוּף אֵצֶר אַלּוּף דִּישָׁן אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי הַחֹרִי לְאַלֻּפֵיהֶם בְּאֶרֶץ שֵׂעִיר׃

verses.english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the Israelites.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה הַמְּלָכִים אֲשֶׁר מָלְכוּ בְּאֶרֶץ אֱדוֹם לִפְנֵי מְלָךְ־מֶלֶךְ לִבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל׃

verses.english: And Bela, son of Beor, reigned in Edom, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְלֹךְ בֶּאֱדוֹם בֶּלַע בֶּן־בְּעוֹר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ דִּנְהָבָה׃

verses.english: And Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בָּלַע וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו יוֹבָב בֶּן־זֶרַח מִבָּצְרָה׃

verses.english: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת יוֹבָב וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו חֻשָׁם מֵאֶרֶץ הַתֵּימָנִי׃

verses.english: And Husham died, and Hadad, son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the country of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת חֻשָׁם וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַד בֶּן־בְּדַד הַמַּכֶּה אֶת־מִדְיָן בִּשְׂדֵה מוֹאָב וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ עֲוִית׃

verses.english: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת הֲדָד וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שַׂמְלָה מִמַּשְׂרֵקָה׃

verses.english: And Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שַׂמְלָה וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו שָׁאוּל מֵרְחֹבוֹת הַנָּהָר׃

verses.english: And Shaul died, and Baal-Hanan, the son of Achbor, reigned in his place.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת שָׁאוּל וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן־עַכְבּוֹר׃

verses.english: Baal-hanan, son of Achbor, died, and Hadar reigned in his place. His city was named Pau, and his wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-zahab.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּמָת בַּעַל חָנָן בֶּן־עַכְבּוֹר וַיִּמְלֹךְ תַּחְתָּיו הֲדַר וְשֵׁם עִירוֹ פָּעוּ וְשֵׁם אִשְׁתּוֹ מְהֵיטַבְאֵל בַּת־מַטְרֵד בַּת מֵי זָהָב׃

verses.english: And these are the names of the chiefs of Esau, according to their families, according to their places, by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,
verses.hebrew: וְאֵלֶּה שְׁמוֹת אַלּוּפֵי עֵשָׂו לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָם לִמְקֹמֹתָם בִּשְׁמֹתָם אַלּוּף תִּמְנָע אַלּוּף עַלְוָה אַלּוּף יְתֵת׃

verses.english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף אָהֳלִיבָמָה אַלּוּף אֵלָה אַלּוּף פִּינֹן׃

verses.english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף קְנַז אַלּוּף תֵּימָן אַלּוּף מִבְצָר׃

verses.english: chief Magdiel, chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their dwelling places in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of Edom.
verses.hebrew: אַלּוּף מַגְדִּיאֵל אַלּוּף עִירָם אֵלֶּה אַלּוּפֵי אֱדוֹם לְמֹשְׁבֹתָם בְּאֶרֶץ אֲחֻזָּתָם הוּא עֵשָׂו אֲבִי אֱדוֹם׃

verses.english: And Jacob dwelt in the land where his father had sojourned, in the land of Canaan.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשֶׁב יַעֲקֹב בְּאֶרֶץ מְגוּרֵי אָבִיו בְּאֶרֶץ כְּנָעַן׃

verses.english: These are the generations of Jacob. Joseph, seventeen years old, was tending the flock with his brothers. He was a young man with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought a bad report about them to their father.
verses.hebrew: אֵלֶּה תֹּלְדוֹת יַעֲקֹב יוֹסֵף בֶּן־שְׁבַע־עֶשְׂרֵה שָׁנָה הָיָה רֹעֶה אֶת־אֶחָיו בַּצֹּאן וְהוּא נַעַר אֶת־בְּנֵי בִלְהָה וְאֶת־בְּנֵי זִלְפָּה נְשֵׁי אָבִיו וַיָּבֵא יוֹסֵף אֶת־דִּבָּתָם רָעָה אֶל־אֲבִיהֶם׃

verses.english: Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him an ornate tunic.
verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׂרָאֵל אָהַב אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִכָּל־בָּנָיו כִּי־בֶן־זְקֻנִים הוּא לוֹ וְעָשָׂה לוֹ כְּתֹנֶת פַּסִּים׃

verses.english: And when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him and could not speak anything peaceable to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֶחָיו כִּי־אֹתוֹ אָהַב אֲבִיהֶם מִכָּל־אֶחָיו וַיִּשְׂנְאוּ אֹתוֹ וְלֹא יָכְלוּ דַּבְּרוֹ לְשָׁלֹם׃

verses.english: And Joseph dreamed a dream and reported it to his brothers, and they hated him even more.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם וַיַּגֵּד לְאֶחָיו וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: And he said to them, “Hear this dream which I have dreamed:”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵיהֶם שִׁמְעוּ־נָא הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתִּי׃

verses.english: “Behold, we were binding sheaves in the field. My sheaf rose and stood upright, and your sheaves gathered around and bowed down to my sheaf.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה אֲנַחְנוּ מְאַלְּמִים אֲלֻמִּים בְּתוֹךְ הַשָּׂדֶה וְהִנֵּה קָמָה אֲלֻמָּתִי וְגַם־נִצָּבָה וְהִנֵּה תְסֻבֶּינָה אֲלֻמֹּתֵיכֶם וַתִּשְׁתַּחֲוֶיןָ לַאֲלֻמָּתִי׃

verses.english: And his brothers said to him, “Shall you indeed reign over us, or shall you indeed lord over us?” So they hated him even more because of his dreams and because of his words.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ לוֹ אֶחָיו הֲמָלֹךְ תִּמְלֹךְ עָלֵינוּ אִם־מָשׁוֹל תִּמְשֹׁל בָּנוּ וַיּוֹסִפוּ עוֹד שְׂנֹא אֹתוֹ עַל־חֲלֹמֹתָיו וְעַל־דְּבָרָיו׃

verses.english: He dreamed another dream and told it to his brothers, saying, “Behold, I have dreamed another dream: the sun, the moon, and eleven stars were bowing down to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחֲלֹם עוֹד חֲלוֹם אַחֵר וַיְסַפֵּר אֹתוֹ לְאֶחָיו וַיֹּאמֶר הִנֵּה חָלַמְתִּי חֲלוֹם עוֹד וְהִנֵּה הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהַיָּרֵחַ וְאַחַד עָשָׂר כּוֹכָבִים מִשְׁתַּחֲוִים לִי׃

verses.english: He told it to his father and his brothers, and his father rebuked him, saying, “What is this dream you have dreamed? Shall I, your mother, and your brothers indeed come and bow down to you to the ground?”
verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר אֶל־אָבִיו וְאֶל־אֶחָיו וַיִּגְעַר־בּוֹ אָבִיו וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ מָה הַחֲלוֹם הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר חָלָמְתָּ הֲבוֹא נָבוֹא אֲנִי וְאִמְּךָ וְאַחֶיךָ לְהִשְׁתַּחֲוֺת לְךָ אָרְצָה׃

verses.english: His brothers were jealous of him, but his father kept the saying in mind.
verses.hebrew: וַיְקַנְאוּ־בוֹ אֶחָיו וְאָבִיו שָׁמַר אֶת־הַדָּבָר׃

verses.english: Now his brothers went to pasture their father’s sheep at Shechem.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּלְכוּ אֶחָיו לִרְעוֹת אֶת־צֹאן אֲבִיהֶם בִּשְׁכֶם׃

verses.english: And Israel said to Joseph, “Are not your brothers pasturing the sheep at Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” And he replied, “Here I am.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא אַחֶיךָ רֹעִים בִּשְׁכֶם לְכָה וְאֶשְׁלָחֲךָ אֲלֵיהֶם וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ הִנֵּנִי׃

verses.english: And he said to him, “Go now, see if it is well with your brothers and with the sheep, and bring word back to me.” So he sent him from the Valley of Hebron, and he arrived at Shechem.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ לֶךְ־נָא רְאֵה אֶת־שְׁלוֹם אַחֶיךָ וְאֶת־שְׁלוֹם הַצֹּאן וַהֲשִׁבֵנִי דָּבָר וַיִּשְׁלָחֵהוּ מֵעֵמֶק חֶבְרוֹן וַיָּבֹא שְׁכֶמָה׃

verses.english: And a man found him wandering in the field, and the man asked him, saying, “What are you looking for?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָאֵהוּ אִישׁ וְהִנֵּה תֹעֶה בַּשָּׂדֶה וַיִּשְׁאָלֵהוּ הָאִישׁ לֵאמֹר מַה־תְּבַקֵּשׁ׃

verses.english: And he said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are pasturing.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֶת־אַחַי אָנֹכִי מְבַקֵּשׁ הַגִּידָה־נָּא לִי אֵיפֹה הֵם רֹעִים׃

verses.english: And the man said, “They have moved on from here, for I heard them saying, ‘Let us go to Dothan.’” So Joseph went after his brothers and found them in Dothan.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הָאִישׁ נָסְעוּ מִזֶּה כִּי שָׁמַעְתִּי אֹמְרִים נֵלְכָה דֹּתָיְנָה וַיֵּלֶךְ יוֹסֵף אַחַר אֶחָיו וַיִּמְצָאֵם בְּדֹתָן׃

verses.english: And they saw him from afar, and before he came near to them, they maliciously plotted against him to put him to death.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאוּ אֹתוֹ מֵרָחֹק וּבְטֶרֶם יִקְרַב אֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּתְנַכְּלוּ אֹתוֹ לַהֲמִיתוֹ׃

verses.english: And they said to one another, “Behold, that dreamer is coming!”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אִישׁ אֶל־אָחִיו הִנֵּה בַּעַל הַחֲלֹמוֹת הַלָּזֶה בָּא׃

verses.english: “Come now therefore, let us kill him and throw him into one of the pits, and we shall say, ‘A fierce beast has devoured him.’ Then we shall see what will become of his dreams.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה לְכוּ וְנַהַרְגֵהוּ וְנַשְׁלִכֵהוּ בְּאַחַד הַבֹּרוֹת וְאָמַרְנוּ חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ וְנִרְאֶה מַה־יִּהְיוּ חֲלֹמֹתָיו׃

verses.english: Reuben heard this and rescued him from their hands, saying, “Let us not take his life.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁמַע רְאוּבֵן וַיַּצִּלֵהוּ מִיָּדָם וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא נַכֶּנּוּ נָפֶשׁ׃

verses.english: And Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood; throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but do not lay a hand on him”—so that he might deliver him out of their hands to restore him to his father.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם רְאוּבֵן אַל־תִּשְׁפְּכוּ־דָם הַשְׁלִיכוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־הַבּוֹר הַזֶּה אֲשֶׁר בַּמִּדְבָּר וְיָד אַל־תִּשְׁלְחוּ־בוֹ לְמַעַן הַצִּיל אֹתוֹ מִיָּדָם לַהֲשִׁיבוֹ אֶל־אָבִיו׃

verses.english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped him of his tunic, the ornate tunic he was wearing.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר־בָּא יוֹסֵף אֶל־אֶחָיו וַיַּפְשִׁיטוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף אֶת־כֻּתָּנְתּוֹ אֶת־כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים אֲשֶׁר עָלָיו׃

verses.english: They took him and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty; there was no water in it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקָּחֻהוּ וַיַּשְׁלִכוּ אֹתוֹ הַבֹּרָה וְהַבּוֹר רֵק אֵין בּוֹ מָיִם׃

verses.english: They sat down to eat bread. Looking up, they saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, their camels carrying spices, balm, and ladanum, on their way to take them down to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּשְׁבוּ לֶאֱכָל־לֶחֶם וַיִּשְׂאוּ עֵינֵיהֶם וַיִּרְאוּ וְהִנֵּה אֹרְחַת יִשְׁמְעֵאלִים בָּאָה מִגִּלְעָד וּגְמַלֵּיהֶם נֹשְׂאִים נְכֹאת וּצְרִי וָלֹט הוֹלְכִים לְהוֹרִיד מִצְרָיְמָה׃

verses.english: And Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and hide his blood?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה אֶל־אֶחָיו מַה־בֶּצַע כִּי נַהֲרֹג אֶת־אָחִינוּ וְכִסִּינוּ אֶת־דָּמוֹ׃

verses.english: “Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hands be upon him, because he is our brother and our flesh.” And his brothers listened to him.
verses.hebrew: לְכוּ וְנִמְכְּרֶנּוּ לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים וְיָדֵנוּ אַל־תְּהִי־בוֹ כִּי־אָחִינוּ בְשָׂרֵנוּ הוּא וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ אֶחָיו׃

verses.english: Midianite merchants passed by. They drew Joseph up from the pit and sold him to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver, and brought Joseph to Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַבְרוּ אֲנָשִׁים מִדְיָנִים סֹחֲרִים וַיִּמְשְׁכוּ וַיַּעֲלוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִן־הַבּוֹר וַיִּמְכְּרוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף לַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים בְּעֶשְׂרִים כָּסֶף וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶת־יוֹסֵף מִצְרָיְמָה׃

verses.english: Now Reuben returned to the pit, and when he did not see Joseph in the pit, he tore his garments.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב רְאוּבֵן אֶל־הַבּוֹר וְהִנֵּה אֵין־יוֹסֵף בַּבּוֹר וַיִּקְרַע אֶת־בְּגָדָיו׃

verses.english: And he returned to his brothers and said, “The child is gone! And I, where shall I go now?”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אֶל־אֶחָיו וַיֹּאמַר הַיֶּלֶד אֵינֶנּוּ וַאֲנִי אָנָה אֲנִי־בָא׃

verses.english: They took Joseph’s tunic, slaughtered a male goat, and dipped the tunic in its blood.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְחוּ אֶת־כְּתֹנֶת יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁחֲטוּ שְׂעִיר עִזִּים וַיִּטְבְּלוּ אֶת־הַכֻּתֹּנֶת בַּדָּם׃

verses.english: They sent the ornate tunic and brought it to their father, saying, “We found this. Please recognize whether it is your son’s tunic.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְשַׁלְּחוּ אֶת־כְּתֹנֶת הַפַּסִּים וַיָּבִיאוּ אֶל־אֲבִיהֶם וַיֹּאמְרוּ זֹאת מָצָאנוּ הַכֶּר־נָא הַכְּתֹנֶת בִּנְךָ הִוא אִם־לֹא׃

verses.english: He recognized it and said, “It is my son’s tunic! A wild animal has devoured him. Joseph has surely been torn to pieces.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכִּירָהּ וַיֹּאמֶר כְּתֹנֶת בְּנִי חַיָּה רָעָה אֲכָלָתְהוּ טָרֹף טֹרַף יוֹסֵף׃

verses.english: Jacob tore his clothes, put sackcloth around his waist, and mourned his son for many days.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרַע יַעֲקֹב שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּשֶׂם שַׂק בְּמָתְנָיו וַיִּתְאַבֵּל עַל־בְּנוֹ יָמִים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: All his sons and daughters rose to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted, saying, “I will go down mourning to my son in Sheol.” His father wept for him.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֻמוּ כָל־בָּנָיו וְכָל־בְּנֹתָיו לְנַחֲמוֹ וַיְמָאֵן לְהִתְנַחֵם וַיֹּאמֶר כִּי־אֵרֵד אֶל־בְּנִי אָבֵל שְׁאֹלָה וַיֵּבְךְּ אֹתוֹ אָבִיו׃

verses.english: The Medanites sold him in Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, the captain of the guard.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמְּדָנִים מָכְרוּ אֹתוֹ אֶל־מִצְרָיִם לְפוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים׃

verses.english: It came to pass at that time that Judah went down from his brothers and turned aside to a certain Adullamite man named Hirah.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בָּעֵת הַהִוא וַיֵּרֶד יְהוּדָה מֵאֵת אֶחָיו וַיֵּט עַד־אִישׁ עֲדֻלָּמִי וּשְׁמוֹ חִירָה׃

verses.english: Judah saw there the daughter of a Canaanite man named Shua. He took her as his wife and went in to her.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא־שָׁם יְהוּדָה בַּת־אִישׁ כְּנַעֲנִי וּשְׁמוֹ שׁוּעַ וַיִּקָּחֶהָ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ׃

verses.english: She conceived and bore a son, and he named him Er.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ עֵר׃

verses.english: And she conceived again and bore a son, and she called his name Onan.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּהַר עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ אוֹנָן׃

verses.english: She bore another son and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּסֶף עוֹד וַתֵּלֶד בֵּן וַתִּקְרָא אֶת־שְׁמוֹ שֵׁלָה וְהָיָה בִכְזִיב בְּלִדְתָּהּ אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: And Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח יְהוּדָה אִשָּׁה לְעֵר בְּכוֹרוֹ וּשְׁמָהּ תָּמָר׃

verses.english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in YHWH’s sight, and YHWH put him to death.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי עֵר בְּכוֹר יְהוּדָה רַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה וַיְמִתֵהוּ יְהוָה׃

verses.english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, perform a brother-in-law’s duty to her, and raise up seed for your brother.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְאוֹנָן בֹּא אֶל־אֵשֶׁת אָחִיךָ וְיַבֵּם אֹתָהּ וְהָקֵם זֶרַע לְאָחִיךָ׃

verses.english: Onan knew that the seed would not be his, so whenever he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground to avoid giving seed to his brother.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּדַע אוֹנָן כִּי לֹּא לוֹ יִהְיֶה הַזָּרַע וְהָיָה אִם־בָּא אֶל־אֵשֶׁת אָחִיו וְשִׁחֵת אַרְצָה לְבִלְתִּי נְתָן־זֶרַע לְאָחִיו׃

verses.english: What he did was wicked in YHWH’s sight, and He put him to death also.
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּרַע בְּעֵינֵי יְהוָה אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וַיָּמֶת גַּם־אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: Then Judah said to his daughter-in-law Tamar, “Remain as a widow in your father’s house until my son Shelah grows up”—for he said to himself, “Lest he also die like his brothers.” So Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה לְתָמָר כַּלָּתוֹ שְׁבִי אַלְמָנָה בֵית־אָבִיךְ עַד־יִגְדַּל שֵׁלָה בְנִי כִּי אָמַר פֶּן־יָמוּת גַּם־הוּא כְּאֶחָיו וַתֵּלֶךְ תָּמָר וַתֵּשֶׁב בֵּית אָבִיהָ׃

verses.english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, Judah’s wife, died. When Judah was comforted, he went up to his sheepshearers at Timnah with his friend Hirah the Adullamite.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְבּוּ הַיָּמִים וַתָּמָת בַּת־שׁוּעַ אֵשֶׁת־יְהוּדָה וַיִּנָּחֶם יְהוּדָה וַיַּעַל עַל־גֹּזֲזֵי צֹאנוֹ הוּא וְחִירָה רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי תִּמְנָתָה׃

verses.english: And it was reported to Tamar, saying, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֻּגַּד לְתָמָר לֵאמֹר הִנֵּה חָמִיךְ עֹלֶה תִמְנָתָה לָגֹז צֹאנוֹ׃

verses.english: She removed her widow’s garments, covered herself with a veil, wrapped herself up, and sat at the entrance to Enaim on the road to Timnah. For she saw that Shelah had grown up, but she had not been given to him as a wife.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּסַר בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתְּכַס בַּצָּעִיף וַתִּתְעַלָּף וַתֵּשֶׁב בְּפֶתַח עֵינַיִם אֲשֶׁר עַל־דֶּרֶךְ תִּמְנָתָה כִּי רָאֲתָה כִּי־גָדַל שֵׁלָה וְהִוא לֹא־נִתְּנָה לוֹ לְאִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: Judah saw her and thought she was a prostitute, because she had covered her face.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּרְאֶהָ יְהוּדָה וַיַּחְשְׁבֶהָ לְזוֹנָה כִּי כִסְּתָה פָּנֶיהָ׃

verses.english: And he turned aside to her by the wayside and said, “Allow me to come in to you”—for he did not know that she was his daughter-in-law. And she said, “What will you give me if you come in to me?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֵּט אֵלֶיהָ אֶל־הַדֶּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמֶר הָבָה־נָּא אָבוֹא אֵלַיִךְ כִּי לֹא יָדַע כִּי כַלָּתוֹ הִוא וַתֹּאמֶר מַה־תִּתֶּן־לִּי כִּי תָבוֹא אֵלָי׃

verses.english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge until you send it?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אָנֹכִי אֲשַׁלַּח גְּדִי־עִזִּים מִן־הַצֹּאן וַתֹּאמֶר אִם־תִּתֵּן עֵרָבוֹן עַד שָׁלְחֶךָ׃

verses.english: He said, “What pledge shall I give you?” She said, “Your signet, your cord, and the staff in your hand.” He gave them to her and went in to her, and she conceived by him.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר מָה הָעֵרָבוֹן אֲשֶׁר אֶתֶּן־לָּךְ וַתֹּאמֶר חֹתָמְךָ וּפְתִילֶךָ וּמַטְּךָ אֲשֶׁר בְּיָדֶךָ וַיִּתֶּן־לָּהּ וַיָּבֹא אֵלֶיהָ וַתַּהַר לוֹ׃

verses.english: Then she arose and departed; she took off her veil and put on her widow’s garments once again.
verses.hebrew: וַתָּקָם וַתֵּלֶךְ וַתָּסַר צְעִיפָהּ מֵעָלֶיהָ וַתִּלְבַּשׁ בִּגְדֵי אַלְמְנוּתָהּ׃

verses.english: Judah sent the young goat by his friend the Adullamite to recover the pledge from the woman, but he did not find her.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח יְהוּדָה אֶת־גְּדִי הָעִזִּים בְּיַד רֵעֵהוּ הָעֲדֻלָּמִי לָקַחַת הָעֵרָבוֹן מִיַּד הָאִשָּׁה וְלֹא מְצָאָהּ׃

verses.english: Then he questioned the men of that place, saying, “Where is the prostitute who was by the road at Enaim?” They replied, “There has been no prostitute here.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־אַנְשֵׁי מְקֹמָהּ לֵאמֹר אַיֵּה הַקְּדֵשָׁה הִוא בָעֵינַיִם עַל־הַדָּרֶךְ וַיֹּאמְרוּ לֹא־הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

verses.english: So he returned to Judah and said, “I didn’t find her. The men of the place even said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשָׁב אֶל־יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר לֹא מְצָאתִיהָ וְגַם אַנְשֵׁי הַמָּקוֹם אָמְרוּ לֹא־הָיְתָה בָזֶה קְדֵשָׁה׃

verses.english: And Judah said, “Let her keep them for herself, lest we become a laughingstock. Behold, I sent this kid, and you did not find her.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה תִּקַּח־לָהּ פֶּן נִהְיֶה לָבוּז הִנֵּה שָׁלַחְתִּי הַגְּדִי הַזֶּה וְאַתָּה לֹא מְצָאתָהּ׃

verses.english: About three months later Judah was told, “Your daughter-in-law Tamar has acted as a prostitute, and now she is pregnant through prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out and let her be burned.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמִשְׁלֹשׁ חֳדָשִׁים וַיֻּגַּד לִיהוּדָה לֵאמֹר זָנְתָה תָּמָר כַּלָּתֶךָ וְגַם הִנֵּה הָרָה לִזְנוּנִים וַיֹּאמֶר יְהוּדָה הוֹצִיאוּהָ וְתִשָּׂרֵף׃

verses.english: As she was being brought out, she sent word to her father-in-law: “I am pregnant by the man to whom these belong.” She said, “Please recognize whose signet, cords, and staff these are.”
verses.hebrew: הִוא מוּצֵאת וְהִיא שָׁלְחָה אֶל־חָמִיהָ לֵאמֹר לְאִישׁ אֲשֶׁר־אֵלֶּה לּוֹ אָנֹכִי הָרָה וַתֹּאמֶר הַכֶּר־נָא לְמִי הַחֹתֶמֶת וְהַפְּתִילִים וְהַמַּטֶּה הָאֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: Judah recognized them and said, “She is more in the right than I, because I did not give her to Shelah my son.” He did not know her again.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּכֵּר יְהוּדָה וַיֹּאמֶר צָדְקָה מִמֶּנִּי כִּי־עַל־כֵּן לֹא־נְתַתִּיהָ לְשֵׁלָה בְנִי וְלֹא־יָסַף עוֹד לְדַעְתָּה׃

verses.english: And it came to pass when she was giving birth, behold, there were twins in her womb.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְּעֵת לִדְתָּהּ וְהִנֵּה תְאוֹמִים בְּבִטְנָהּ׃

verses.english: As she gave birth, one put out a hand. The midwife took it and tied a scarlet thread around it, saying, “This one came out first.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בְלִדְתָּהּ וַיִּתֶּן־יָד וַתִּקַּח הַמְיַלֶּדֶת וַתִּקְשֹׁר עַל־יָדוֹ שָׁנִי לֵאמֹר זֶה יָצָא רִאשֹׁנָה׃

verses.english: But as he drew back his hand, his brother came out. She said, “What a breach you have made for yourself!” He was named Perez.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּמֵשִׁיב יָדוֹ וְהִנֵּה יָצָא אָחִיו וַתֹּאמֶר מַה־פָּרַצְתָּ עָלֶיךָ פָּרֶץ וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ פָּרֶץ׃

verses.english: Afterward his brother came out, with the scarlet thread on his hand; he was named Zerah.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחַר יָצָא אָחִיו אֲשֶׁר עַל־יָדוֹ הַשָּׁנִי וַיִּקְרָא שְׁמוֹ זָרַח׃

verses.english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh, captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the Ishmaelites who had brought him down there.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף הוּרַד מִצְרָיְמָה וַיִּקְנֵהוּ פּוֹטִיפַר סְרִיס פַּרְעֹה שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אִישׁ מִצְרִי מִיַּד הַיִּשְׁמְעֵאלִים אֲשֶׁר הוֹרִדֻהוּ שָׁמָּה׃

verses.english: And YHWH was with Joseph, and he was a successful man, and he lived in the house of his Egyptian master.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת־יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי אִישׁ מַצְלִיחַ וַיְהִי בְּבֵית אֲדֹנָיו הַמִּצְרִי׃

verses.english: His master saw that YHWH was with him and that YHWH made everything he did prosper in his hands.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא אֲדֹנָיו כִּי יְהוָה אִתּוֹ וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהוָה מַצְלִיחַ בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: Joseph found favor in his sight and served him. He appointed Joseph over his household and entrusted everything he owned to him.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּמְצָא יוֹסֵף חֵן בְּעֵינָיו וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתוֹ וַיַּפְקִדֵהוּ עַל־בֵּיתוֹ וְכָל־יֶשׁ־לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: And it came to pass after he had appointed him over his house and over all that he owned, that YHWH blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake; and the blessing of YHWH was upon all that belonged to him, both in the house and in the field.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מֵאָז הִפְקִיד אֹתוֹ בְּבֵיתוֹ וְעַל כָּל־אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ־לוֹ וַיְבָרֶךְ יְהוָה אֶת־בֵּית הַמִּצְרִי בִּגְלַל יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי בִּרְכַּת יְהוָה בְּכָל־אֲשֶׁר יֶשׁ־לוֹ בַּבַּיִת וּבַשָּׂדֶה׃

verses.english: He left everything he owned in Joseph’s hands and concerned himself with nothing except the bread he ate. Joseph was handsome in form and appearance.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעֲזֹב כָּל־אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ בְּיַד־יוֹסֵף וְלֹא־יָדַע אִתּוֹ מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם־הַלֶּחֶם אֲשֶׁר־הוּא אוֹכֵל וַיְהִי יוֹסֵף יְפֵה־תֹאַר וִיפֵה מַרְאֶה׃

verses.english: And it came to pass after these things that his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said, “Sleep with me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה וַתִּשָּׂא אֵשֶׁת־אֲדֹנָיו אֶת־עֵינֶיהָ אֶל־יוֹסֵף וַתֹּאמֶר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי׃

verses.english: He refused and said to his master’s wife, “My master leaves all household matters to me and has entrusted everything he owns to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְמָאֵן וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־אֵשֶׁת אֲדֹנָיו הֵן אֲדֹנִי לֹא־יָדַע אִתִּי מַה־בַּבָּיִת וְכֹל אֲשֶׁר־יֶשׁ־לוֹ נָתַן בְּיָדִי׃

verses.english: “He is no greater in this house than I, and he has withheld nothing from me except you, because you are his wife. How could I do this great evil and sin against God?”
verses.hebrew: אֵינֶנּוּ גָדוֹל בַּבַּיִת הַזֶּה מִמֶּנִּי וְלֹא־חָשַׂךְ מִמֶּנִּי מְאוּמָה כִּי אִם־אוֹתָךְ בַּאֲשֶׁר אַתְּ־אִשְׁתּוֹ וְאֵיךְ אֶעֱשֶׂה הָרָעָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְחָטָאתִי לֵאלֹהִים׃

verses.english: Although she spoke to Joseph day after day, he would not listen to her, to lie beside her or be with her.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּדַבְּרָהּ אֶל־יוֹסֵף יוֹם יוֹם וְלֹא־שָׁמַע אֵלֶיהָ לִשְׁכַּב אֶצְלָהּ לִהְיוֹת עִמָּהּ׃

verses.english: One day he entered the house to do his work, and none of the household men were inside.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְּהַיּוֹם הַזֶּה וַיָּבֹא הַבַּיְתָה לַעֲשׂוֹת מְלַאכְתּוֹ וְאֵין אִישׁ מֵאַנְשֵׁי הַבַּיִת שָׁם בַּבָּיִת׃

verses.english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand and fled outside.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּתְפְּשֵׂהוּ בְּבִגְדוֹ לֵאמֹר שִׁכְבָה עִמִּי וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

verses.english: And it came to pass, when she saw that he had left his garment in her hand and had fled outside,
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִּרְאוֹתָהּ כִּי־עָזַב בִּגְדוֹ בְּיָדָהּ וַיָּנָס הַחוּצָה׃

verses.english: she called the household men and said to them, “See, he has brought us a Hebrew man to mock us. He came in to lie with me, and I cried out loudly.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּקְרָא לְאַנְשֵׁי בֵיתָהּ וַתֹּאמֶר לָהֶם לֵאמֹר רְאוּ הֵבִיא לָנוּ אִישׁ עִבְרִי לְצַחֶק בָּנוּ בָּא אֵלַי לִשְׁכַּב עִמִּי וָאֶקְרָא בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל׃

verses.english: “And it came to pass, when he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried out, that he left his garment beside me, and fled and went outside.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כְשָׁמְעוֹ כִּי־הֲרִימֹתִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנָס וַיֵּצֵא הַחוּצָה׃

verses.english: So she left his garment beside her until his master came home.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּנַּח בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלָהּ עַד־בּוֹא אֲדֹנָיו אֶל־בֵּיתוֹ׃

verses.english: She told him the same story: “The Hebrew slave you brought us came in to mock me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתְּדַבֵּר אֵלָיו כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה לֵאמֹר בָּא־אֵלַי הָעֶבֶד הָעִבְרִי אֲשֶׁר־הֵבֵאתָ לָּנוּ לְצַחֶק בִּי׃

verses.english: “But when I lifted up my voice and cried out, he left his garment beside me and fled outside.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּהֲרִימִי קוֹלִי וָאֶקְרָא וַיַּעֲזֹב בִּגְדוֹ אֶצְלִי וַיָּנָס הַחוּצָה׃

verses.english: When his master heard his wife’s account, saying, “This is how your servant treated me,” he became angry.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כִשְׁמֹעַ אֲדֹנָיו אֶת־דִּבְרֵי אִשְׁתּוֹ אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרָה אֵלָיו לֵאמֹר כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה עָשָׂהּ לִי עַבְדֶּךָ וַיִּחַר אַפּוֹ׃

verses.english: Joseph’s master took him and put him in the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were confined. He remained there in prison.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקַּח אֲדֹנֵי יוֹסֵף אֹתוֹ וַיִּתְּנֵהוּ אֶל־בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר־אסורי [אֲסִירֵי] הַמֶּלֶךְ אֲסוּרִים וַיְהִי־שָׁם בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

verses.english: YHWH was with Joseph, extended kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the prison keeper.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי יְהוָה אֶת־יוֹסֵף וַיֵּט אֵלָיו חָסֶד וַיִּתֵּן חִנּוֹ בְּעֵינֵי שַׂר בֵּית־הַסֹּהַר׃

verses.english: The prison keeper put all the prisoners in Joseph’s charge. Whatever was done there, he was responsible for it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן שַׂר בֵּית־הַסֹּהַר בְּיַד־יוֹסֵף אֵת כָּל־הָאֲסִירִם אֲשֶׁר בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר וְאֵת כָּל־אֲשֶׁר עֹשִׂים שָׁם הוּא הָיָה עֹשֶׂה׃

verses.english: The prison keeper did not inspect anything in Joseph’s charge, because YHWH was with him. Whatever he did, YHWH made it prosper.
verses.hebrew: אֵין שַׂר בֵּית־הַסֹּהַר רֹאֶה אֶת־כָּל־מְאוּמָה בְּיָדוֹ בַּאֲשֶׁר יְהוָה אִתּוֹ וַאֲשֶׁר־הוּא עֹשֶׂה יְהוָה מַצְלִיחַ׃

verses.english: After these things, the king of Egypt’s cupbearer and baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי אַחַר הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה חָטְאוּ מַשְׁקֵה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרַיִם וְהָאֹפֶה לַאֲדֹנֵיהֶם לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cupbearer and the chief baker.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְצֹף פַּרְעֹה עַל שְׁנֵי סָרִיסָיו עַל שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְעַל שַׂר הָאוֹפִים׃

verses.english: He put them in custody in the captain of the guard’s house, in the prison where Joseph was confined.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָם בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַבָּחִים אֶל־בֵּית הַסֹּהַר מְקוֹם אֲשֶׁר יוֹסֵף אָסוּר שָׁם׃

verses.english: The captain of the guard assigned Joseph to them, and he served them. They remained in custody for some time.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּפְקֹד שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֶת־יוֹסֵף אִתָּם וַיְשָׁרֶת אֹתָם וַיִּהְיוּ יָמִים בְּמִשְׁמָר׃

verses.english: Both dreamed a dream that same night, each his own dream with its own interpretation: the king of Egypt’s cupbearer and baker, who were confined in prison.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּחַלְמוּ חֲלוֹם שְׁנֵיהֶם אִישׁ חֲלֹמוֹ בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ הַמַּשְׁקֶה וְהָאֹפֶה אֲשֶׁר לְמֶלֶךְ מִצְרַיִם אֲשֶׁר אֲסוּרִים בְּבֵית הַסֹּהַר׃

verses.english: Joseph came to them in the morning and saw that they were troubled.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֲלֵיהֶם יוֹסֵף בַּבֹּקֶר וַיַּרְא אֹתָם וְהִנָּם זֹעֲפִים׃

verses.english: So he questioned Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why are your faces so gloomy today?”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁאַל אֶת־סְרִיסֵי פַרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר אִתּוֹ בְמִשְׁמַר בֵּית אֲדֹנָיו לֵאמֹר מַדּוּעַ פְּנֵיכֶם רָעִים הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one to interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Do not interpretations belong to God? Please tell me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמְרוּ אֵלָיו חֲלוֹם חָלַמְנוּ וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַיֹּאמֶר אֲלֵהֶם יוֹסֵף הֲלוֹא לֵאלֹהִים פִּתְרֹנִים סַפְּרוּ־נָא לִי׃

verses.english: Then the chief cupbearer recounted his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was before me,”
verses.hebrew: וַיְסַפֵּר שַׂר־הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת־חֲלֹמוֹ לְיוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה־גֶפֶן לְפָנָי׃

verses.english: “and on the vine were three branches. It was blooming, and its blossoms shot forth, and its clusters of grapes became ripe.”
verses.hebrew: וּבַגֶּפֶן שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׂרִיגִם וְהִיא כְפֹרַחַת עָלְתָה נִצָּהּ הִבְשִׁילוּ אַשְׁכְּלֹתֶיהָ עֲנָבִים׃

verses.english: “And Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, squeezed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and placed the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”
verses.hebrew: וְכוֹס פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדִי וָאֶקַּח אֶת־הָעֲנָבִים וָאֶשְׂחַט אֹתָם אֶל־כּוֹס פַּרְעֹה וָאֶתֵּן אֶת־הַכּוֹס עַל־כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: And Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: The three branches are three days.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לוֹ יוֹסֵף זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַשָּׂרִגִים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

verses.english: “Within three days Pharaoh will lift up your head and restore you to your position. You will put Pharaoh’s cup in his hand as you did before, when you were his cupbearer.”
verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת־רֹאשֶׁךָ וַהֲשִׁיבְךָ עַל־כַּנֶּךָ וְנָתַתָּ כוֹס־פַּרְעֹה בְּיָדוֹ כַּמִּשְׁפָּט הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר הָיִיתָ מַשְׁקֵהוּ׃

verses.english: “Remember me when it goes well with you. Please show me kindness, mention me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי אִם־זְכַרְתַּנִי אִתְּךָ כַּאֲשֶׁר יִיטַב לָךְ וְעָשִׂיתָ־נָּא עִמָּדִי חָסֶד וְהִזְכַּרְתַּנִי אֶל־פַּרְעֹה וְהוֹצֵאתַנִי מִן־הַבַּיִת הַזֶּה׃

verses.english: “I was indeed stolen from the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing to deserve being put in this pit.”
verses.hebrew: כִּי־גֻנֹּב גֻּנַּבְתִּי מֵאֶרֶץ הָעִבְרִים וְגַם־פֹּה לֹא־עָשִׂיתִי מְאוּמָה כִּי־שָׂמוּ אֹתִי בַּבּוֹר׃

verses.english: The chief baker saw that the interpretation was favorable and said to Joseph, “I too had a dream: there were three baskets of white bread on my head.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְא שַׂר־הָאֹפִים כִּי טוֹב פָּתָר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶל־יוֹסֵף אַף־אֲנִי בַּחֲלוֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שְׁלֹשָׁה סַלֵּי חֹרִי עַל־רֹאשִׁי׃

verses.english: “In the top basket were all kinds of baked food for Pharaoh, and the birds were eating it from the basket on my head.”
verses.hebrew: וּבַסַּל הָעֶלְיוֹן מִכֹּל מַאֲכַל פַּרְעֹה מַעֲשֵׂה אֹפֶה וְהָעוֹף אֹכֵל אֹתָם מִן־הַסַּל מֵעַל רֹאשִׁי׃

verses.english: And Joseph answered and said, “This is its interpretation: The three baskets are three days.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף וַיֹּאמֶר זֶה פִּתְרֹנוֹ שְׁלֹשֶׁת הַסַּלִּים שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים הֵם׃

verses.english: “Within three days Pharaoh will lift your head from you and hang you on a tree, and the birds will eat your flesh from you.”
verses.hebrew: בְּעוֹד שְׁלֹשֶׁת יָמִים יִשָּׂא פַרְעֹה אֶת־רֹאשְׁךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ וְתָלָה אוֹתְךָ עַל־עֵץ וְאָכַל הָעוֹף אֶת־בְּשָׂרְךָ מֵעָלֶיךָ׃

verses.english: On the third day, Pharaoh’s birthday, he made a feast for all his servants and lifted up the heads of the chief cupbearer and chief baker among his servants.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַּיּוֹם הַשְּׁלִישִׁי יוֹם הֻלֶּדֶת אֶת־פַּרְעֹה וַיַּעַשׂ מִשְׁתֶּה לְכָל־עֲבָדָיו וַיִּשָּׂא אֶת־רֹאשׁ שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים וְאֶת־רֹאשׁ שַׂר הָאֹפִים בְּתוֹךְ עֲבָדָיו׃

verses.english: And he restored the chief cupbearer to his office, and he placed the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּשֶׁב אֶת־שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים עַל־מַשְׁקֵהוּ וַיִּתֵּן הַכּוֹס עַל־כַּף פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: But he hanged the chief baker, just as Joseph had interpreted for them.
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים תָּלָה כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר לָהֶם יוֹסֵף׃

verses.english: Yet the chief cupbearer did not remember Joseph, but forgot him.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־זָכַר שַׂר־הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת־יוֹסֵף וַיִּשְׁכָּחֵהוּ׃

verses.english: At the end of two full years, Pharaoh dreamed that he was standing beside the Nile.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי מִקֵּץ שְׁנָתַיִם יָמִים וּפַרְעֹה חֹלֵם וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד עַל־הַיְאֹר׃

verses.english: And behold, there came up out of the river seven cows, beautiful in appearance and fat of flesh, and they grazed in the reed grass.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מִן־הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת יְפוֹת מַרְאֶה וּבְרִיאֹת בָּשָׂר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

verses.english: And behold, seven other cows came up after them out of the river, ugly in appearance and thin of flesh, and they stood by the other cows on the bank of the river.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן מִן־הַיְאֹר רָעוֹת מַרְאֶה וְדַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אֵצֶל הַפָּרוֹת עַל־שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

verses.english: And the ugly, thin cows ate up the seven beautiful, fat cows. Then Pharaoh awoke.
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת רָעוֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְדַקֹּת הַבָּשָׂר אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת יְפֹת הַמַּרְאֶה וְהַבְּרִיאֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: And he fell asleep and dreamed a second time; and behold, seven ears of grain came up on a single stalk, plump and good.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּישָׁן וַיַּחֲלֹם שֵׁנִית וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלוֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד בְּרִיאוֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

verses.english: Seven thin ears of grain, scorched by the east wind, sprang up after them.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים דַּקּוֹת וּשְׁדוּפֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן׃

verses.english: And the thin ears swallowed up the seven plump, full ears. Then Pharaoh awoke, and behold, it was a dream.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְלַעְנָה הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקּוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַבְּרִיאוֹת וְהַמְּלֵאוֹת וַיִּיקַץ פַּרְעֹה וְהִנֵּה חֲלוֹם׃

verses.english: In the morning his spirit was troubled. He sent for all Egypt’s magicians and wise men and told them his dream, but no one interpreted the dreams for Pharaoh.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בַבֹּקֶר וַתִּפָּעֶם רוּחוֹ וַיִּשְׁלַח וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־כָּל־חַרְטֻמֵּי מִצְרַיִם וְאֶת־כָּל־חֲכָמֶיהָ וַיְסַפֵּר פַּרְעֹה לָהֶם אֶת־חֲלֹמוֹ וְאֵין־פּוֹתֵר אוֹתָם לְפַרְעֹה׃

verses.english: The chief cupbearer said to Pharaoh, “Today I remember my offenses.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר שַׂר הַמַּשְׁקִים אֶת־פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר אֶת־חֲטָאַי אֲנִי מַזְכִּיר הַיּוֹם׃

verses.english: “Pharaoh was angry with his servants and put me in custody in the captain of the guard’s house, me and the chief baker.”
verses.hebrew: פַּרְעֹה קָצַף עַל־עֲבָדָיו וַיִּתֵּן אֹתִי בְּמִשְׁמַר בֵּית שַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים אֹתִי וְאֵת שַׂר הָאֹפִים׃

verses.english: “And we dreamed a dream in the same night, he and I; each of us dreamed according to the interpretation of his own dream.”
verses.hebrew: וַנַּחַלְמָה חֲלוֹם בְּלַיְלָה אֶחָד אֲנִי וָהוּא אִישׁ כְּפִתְרוֹן חֲלֹמוֹ חָלָמְנוּ׃

verses.english: “A young Hebrew man was there with us, a servant of the captain of the guard. We told him our dreams, and he interpreted them for us, each according to his dream.”
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁם אִתָּנוּ נַעַר עִבְרִי עֶבֶד לְשַׂר הַטַּבָּחִים וַנְּסַפֶּר־לוֹ וַיִּפְתָּר־לָנוּ אֶת־חֲלֹמֹתֵינוּ אִישׁ כַּחֲלֹמוֹ פָּתָר׃

verses.english: “As he interpreted for us, so it happened: he restored me to my position and hanged the other man.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי כַּאֲשֶׁר פָּתַר־לָנוּ כֵּן הָיָה אֹתִי הֵשִׁיב עַל־כַּנִּי וְאֹתוֹ תָלָה׃

verses.english: Pharaoh sent for Joseph, and they hurried him out of the pit. He shaved, changed his clothes, and came to Pharaoh.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁלַח פַּרְעֹה וַיִּקְרָא אֶת־יוֹסֵף וַיְרִיצֻהוּ מִן־הַבּוֹר וַיְגַלַּח וַיְחַלֵּף שִׂמְלֹתָיו וַיָּבֹא אֶל־פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I have dreamed a dream, and no one can interpret it. I have heard it said of you that when you hear a dream, you can interpret it.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יוֹסֵף חֲלוֹם חָלַמְתִּי וּפֹתֵר אֵין אֹתוֹ וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי עָלֶיךָ לֵאמֹר תִּשְׁמַע חֲלוֹם לִפְתֹּר אֹתוֹ׃

verses.english: Joseph answered Pharaoh, “It is not in me. God will give Pharaoh an answer of peace.”
verses.hebrew: וַיַּעַן יוֹסֵף אֶת־פַּרְעֹה לֵאמֹר בִּלְעָדָי אֱלֹהִים יַעֲנֶה אֶת־שְׁלוֹם פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: And Pharaoh spoke to Joseph, saying, “In my dream, behold, I was standing upon the bank of the river.”
verses.hebrew: וַיְדַבֵּר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יוֹסֵף בַּחֲלֹמִי הִנְנִי עֹמֵד עַל־שְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

verses.english: “And behold, seven cows came up out of the river, fat in flesh and beautiful in appearance, and they grazed in the reed grass.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה מִן־הַיְאֹר עֹלֹת שֶׁבַע פָּרוֹת בְּרִיאוֹת בָּשָׂר וִיפֹת תֹּאַר וַתִּרְעֶינָה בָּאָחוּ׃

verses.english: “Seven other cows came up after them, poor, very ugly, and thin in flesh. I have never seen such bad-looking cows in all Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע־פָּרוֹת אֲחֵרוֹת עֹלוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן דַּלּוֹת וְרָעוֹת תֹּאַר מְאֹד וְרַקּוֹת בָּשָׂר לֹא־רָאִיתִי כָהֵנָּה בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לָרֹעַ׃

verses.english: “And the ugly, thin cows ate up the first seven fat cows.”
verses.hebrew: וַתֹּאכַלְנָה הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעוֹת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרִאשֹׁנוֹת הַבְּרִיאֹת׃

verses.english: “They went into their bellies, but there was no sign they had gone in. They looked as ugly as before. Then I woke up.”
verses.hebrew: וַתָּבֹאנָה אֶל־קִרְבֶּנָה וְלֹא נוֹדַע כִּי־בָאוּ אֶל־קִרְבֶּנָה וּמַרְאֵיהֶן רַע כַּאֲשֶׁר בַּתְּחִלָּה וָאִיקָץ׃

verses.english: “I saw in my dream seven ears of grain coming up on one stalk, full and good.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֵרֶא בַּחֲלֹמִי וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים עֹלֹת בְּקָנֶה אֶחָד מְלֵאֹת וְטֹבוֹת׃

verses.english: “Seven withered, thin ears, scorched by the east wind, sprang up after them.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שִׁבֳּלִים צְנֻמוֹת דַּקּוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת קָדִים צֹמְחוֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶם׃

verses.english: “The thin ears swallowed the seven good ears. I told the magicians, but no one explained it to me.”
verses.hebrew: וַתִּבְלַעְןָ הָשִׁבֳּלִים הַדַּקֹּת אֵת שֶׁבַע הַשִׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבוֹת וָאֹמַר אֶל־הַחַרְטֻמִּים וְאֵין מַגִּיד לִי׃

verses.english: Joseph said to Pharaoh, “Pharaoh’s dream is one. God has told Pharaoh what He is about to do.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר יוֹסֵף אֶל־פַּרְעֹה חֲלוֹם פַּרְעֹה אֶחָד הוּא אֵת אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הִגִּיד לְפַרְעֹה׃

verses.english: “The seven good cows are seven years, and the seven good ears are seven years; the dream is one and the same.”
verses.hebrew: שֶׁבַע פָּרֹת הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִּׁבֳּלִים הַטֹּבֹת שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה חֲלוֹם אֶחָד הוּא׃

verses.english: “The seven thin, ugly cows that came up after them are seven years, and the seven empty ears scorched by the east wind will be seven years of famine.”
verses.hebrew: וְשֶׁבַע הַפָּרוֹת הָרַקּוֹת וְהָרָעֹת הָעֹלֹת אַחֲרֵיהֶן שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים הֵנָּה וְשֶׁבַע הַשִׁבֳּלִים הָרֵקוֹת שְׁדֻפוֹת הַקָּדִים יִהְיוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב׃

verses.english: “This is the very thing that I have spoken to Pharaoh: what God is about to perform, He has shown to Pharaoh.”
verses.hebrew: הוּא הַדָּבָר אֲשֶׁר דִּבַּרְתִּי אֶל־פַּרְעֹה אֲשֶׁר הָאֱלֹהִים עֹשֶׂה הֶרְאָה אֶת־פַּרְעֹה׃

verses.english: “Behold, seven years of great abundance are coming throughout all the land of Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: הִנֵּה שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים בָּאוֹת שָׂבָע גָּדוֹל בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: “And seven years of famine will arise after them, and all the abundance will be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine will consume the land.”
verses.hebrew: וְקָמוּ שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי רָעָב אַחֲרֵיהֶן וְנִשְׁכַּח כָּל־הַשָּׂבָע בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְכִלָּה הָרָעָב אֶת־הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: “And the abundance will not be known in the land by reason of that famine following it, for it will be exceedingly severe.”
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא־יִוָּדַע הַשָּׂבָע בָּאָרֶץ מִפְּנֵי הָרָעָב הַהוּא אַחֲרֵי־כֵן כִּי־כָבֵד הוּא מְאֹד׃

verses.english: “The dream was repeated to Pharaoh twice because the matter is established by God, and God will hasten to do it.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַל הִשָּׁנוֹת הַחֲלוֹם אֶל־פַּרְעֹה פַּעֲמָיִם כִּי־נָכוֹן הַדָּבָר מֵעִם הָאֱלֹהִים וּמְמַהֵר הָאֱלֹהִים לַעֲשֹׂתוֹ׃

verses.english: “Now therefore, let Pharaoh look for a discerning and prudent man, and set him over the land of Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה יֵרֶא פַרְעֹה אִישׁ נָבוֹן וְחָכָם וִישִׁיתֵהוּ עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: “Let Pharaoh act and appoint overseers over the land, and take a fifth of Egypt’s produce during the seven years of abundance.”
verses.hebrew: יַעֲשֶׂה פַרְעֹה וְיַפְקֵד פְּקִדִים עַל־הָאָרֶץ וְחִמֵּשׁ אֶת־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע׃

verses.english: “And let them gather all the food of these good years that are coming, and let the grain be gathered under the hand of Pharaoh, and let food be kept in the cities.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִקְבְּצוּ אֶת־כָּל־אֹכֶל הַשָּׁנִים הַטֹּבֹת הַבָּאֹת הָאֵלֶּה וְיִצְבְּרוּ־בָר תַּחַת יַד־פַּרְעֹה אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים וְשָׁמָרוּ׃

verses.english: “And that food shall be held in reserve for the land against the seven years of famine which are about to occur in the land of Egypt, so that the land may not be cut off by the famine.”
verses.hebrew: וְהָיָה הָאֹכֶל לְפִקָּדוֹן לָאָרֶץ לְשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר תִּהְיֶיןָ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם וְלֹא־תִכָּרֵת הָאָרֶץ בָּרָעָב׃

verses.english: And the thing was good in the sight of Pharaoh and in the sight of all his servants.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּיטַב הַדָּבָר בְּעֵינֵי פַרְעֹה וּבְעֵינֵי כָּל־עֲבָדָיו׃

verses.english: And Pharaoh said to his servants, “Shall we find such a man as this, who has the spirit of God in him?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־עֲבָדָיו הֲנִמְצָא כָזֶה אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר רוּחַ אֱלֹהִים בּוֹ׃

verses.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Since God has made all this known to you, no one is as discerning and wise as you.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יוֹסֵף אַחֲרֵי הוֹדִיעַ אֱלֹהִים אוֹתְךָ אֶת־כָּל־זֹאת אֵין־נָבוֹן וְחָכָם כָּמוֹךָ׃

verses.english: “You shall be over my house, and all my people shall obey your word; only in respect to the throne will I exceed you.”
verses.hebrew: אַתָּה תִּהְיֶה עַל־בֵּיתִי וְעַל־פִּיךָ יִשַּׁק כָּל־עַמִּי רַק הַכִּסֵּא אֶגְדַּל מִמֶּךָּ׃

verses.english: And Pharaoh said to Joseph, “Behold, I appoint you over all the land of Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יוֹסֵף רְאֵה נָתַתִּי אֹתְךָ עַל כָּל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Pharaoh took his signet ring from his hand and put it on Joseph’s hand. He clothed him in fine linen garments and put a gold chain around his neck.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּסַר פַּרְעֹה אֶת־טַבַּעְתּוֹ מֵעַל יָדוֹ וַיִּתֵּן אֹתָהּ עַל־יַד יוֹסֵף וַיַּלְבֵּשׁ אֹתוֹ בִּגְדֵי־שֵׁשׁ וַיָּשֶׂם רְבִד הַזָּהָב עַל־צַוָּארוֹ׃

verses.english: He had him ride in his second chariot, and they called before him, “Abrek!” He set him over all Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיַּרְכֵּב אֹתוֹ בְּמִרְכֶּבֶת הַמִּשְׁנֶה אֲשֶׁר־לוֹ וַיִּקְרְאוּ לְפָנָיו אַבְרֵךְ וְנָתוֹן אֹתוֹ עַל כָּל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Pharaoh said to Joseph, “I am Pharaoh, and without you no one will lift a hand or foot in all Egypt.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר פַּרְעֹה אֶל־יוֹסֵף אֲנִי פַרְעֹה וּבִלְעָדֶיךָ לֹא־יָרִים אִישׁ אֶת־יָדוֹ וְאֶת־רַגְלוֹ בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Pharaoh named Joseph Zaphenath-paneah and gave him Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, as his wife. Joseph went out over the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא פַרְעֹה שֵׁם־יוֹסֵף צָפְנַת פַּעְנֵחַ וַיִּתֶּן־לוֹ אֶת־אָסְנַת בַּת־פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אֹן לְאִשָּׁה וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף עַל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: Joseph was thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh and journeyed through all the land of Egypt.
verses.hebrew: וְיוֹסֵף בֶּן־שְׁלֹשִׁים שָׁנָה בְּעָמְדוֹ לִפְנֵי פַּרְעֹה מֶלֶךְ־מִצְרָיִם וַיֵּצֵא יוֹסֵף מִלִּפְנֵי פַרְעֹה וַיַּעְבֹר בְּכָל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: During the seven years of abundance, the land produced by the handful.
verses.hebrew: וַתַּעַשׂ הָאָרֶץ בְּשֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע לִקְמָצִים׃

verses.english: And he gathered all the food of the seven years which were in the land of Egypt, and stored the food in the cities; the food from the field surrounding each city he stored within it.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְבֹּץ אֶת־כָּל־אֹכֶל שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם וַיִּתֶּן־אֹכֶל בֶּעָרִים אֹכֶל שְׂדֵה־הָעִיר אֲשֶׁר סְבִיבֹתֶיהָ נָתַן בְּתוֹכָהּ׃

verses.english: Joseph stored grain like the sand of the sea, so much that he stopped counting, for it was beyond counting.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּצְבֹּר יוֹסֵף בָּר כְּחוֹל הַיָּם הַרְבֵּה מְאֹד עַד כִּי־חָדַל לִסְפֹּר כִּי־אֵין מִסְפָּר׃

verses.english: Two sons were born to Joseph before the famine year came. Asenath, daughter of Potiphera, priest of On, bore them to him.
verses.hebrew: וּלְיוֹסֵף יֻלַּד שְׁנֵי בָנִים בְּטֶרֶם תָּבוֹא שְׁנַת הָרָעָב אֲשֶׁר יָלְדָה־לּוֹ אָסְנַת בַּת־פּוֹטִי פֶרַע כֹּהֵן אוֹן׃

verses.english: Joseph named the firstborn Manasseh, “For God has made me forget all my toil and all my father’s house.”
verses.hebrew: וַיִּקְרָא יוֹסֵף אֶת־שֵׁם הַבְּכוֹר מְנַשֶּׁה כִּי־נַשַּׁנִי אֱלֹהִים אֶת־כָּל־עֲמָלִי וְאֵת כָּל־בֵּית אָבִי׃

verses.english: He named the second Ephraim, “For God has made me fruitful in the land of my affliction.”
verses.hebrew: וְאֵת שֵׁם הַשֵּׁנִי קָרָא אֶפְרָיִם כִּי־הִפְרַנִי אֱלֹהִים בְּאֶרֶץ עָנְיִי׃

verses.english: Then the seven years of abundance that were in the land of Egypt passed away.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּכְלֶינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הַשָּׂבָע אֲשֶׁר הָיָה בְּאֶרֶץ מִצְרָיִם׃

verses.english: The seven years of famine began, as Joseph had said. There was famine in all the lands, but throughout Egypt there was bread.
verses.hebrew: וַתְּחִלֶּינָה שֶׁבַע שְׁנֵי הָרָעָב לָבוֹא כַּאֲשֶׁר אָמַר יוֹסֵף וַיְהִי רָעָב בְּכָל־הָאֲרָצוֹת וּבְכָל־אֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם הָיָה לָחֶם׃

verses.english: So when all the land of Egypt hungered, the people cried out to Pharaoh for bread. And Pharaoh said to all the Egyptians, “Go to Joseph; whatever he says to you, do.”
